issues.title: Plan conformance violation: error status code is 500, not 400
issues.message: Finding: Validation error returns HTTP 500. Evidence: src/api/users.js returns res.status(500) on validation failure. Impact: Plan requirement 3 promises 400 Bad Request for invalid input; 500 misclassifies a client error as a server error and breaks the documented contract. Fix: Return res.status(400).json({ error: 'invalid id' }). Severity: critical Confidence: high
evidence: plan.md requirement 3: エラー時は HTTP 400 を返す

issues.title: Backward compatibility risk: response shape changed
issues.message: Finding: Success response shape changed from { user } to { id, name }. Evidence: src/api/users.js now returns res.status(200).json({ id, name }). Impact: Plan requirement 2 promises to keep the { user: { id, name } } shape; flattening it breaks existing clients. Fix: Restore res.status(200).json({ user }). Severity: major Confidence: high
evidence: plan.md requirement 2: 既存 API のレスポンス互換性を維持する
diff.patch: return res.status(200).json({ id: user.id, name: user.name });

issues.title: Missing boundary test for validation
issues.message: Finding: No boundary tests for negative, zero, or non-integer id. Evidence: test-cases.md lists only a 200 happy-path test. Impact: Plan test requirements demand boundary tests returning 400; without them the validation behavior is unverified. Fix: Add tests asserting 400 for id = -1, 0, and 'abc'. Severity: major Confidence: medium
evidence: plan.md test requirements: 境界値テストを追加する
test-cases.md: 不足しているテスト一覧
issues.suggestion: Add boundary tests for id = -1, 0, and a non-integer value, each asserting HTTP 400.
